The 1968–69 [[Super League Greece|Alpha Ethniki]] was the 33rd season of the highest [[Association football|football]] league of Greece. The season began on 22 September 1968 and ended on 15 June 1969. [[Panathinaikos F.C.|Panathinaikos]] won their ninth Greek title and their first one in three years.

The point system was: ''Win: 3 points'' - ''Draw: 2 points'' - ''Loss: 1 point''.
